limitations.note: The agent correctly registered `c1` but unnecessarily renamed `slave_mod`’s `a` and `b` ports, so any external named-port instantiation using the original names would fail to compile.
The test checked timing and reset through `TopModule`, but it never instantiated `slave_mod` through its original named ports, so the interface regression went undetected.
The agent submitted the test three times because the first wrapper used a disallowed cleanup command and the second invoked an unavailable interpreter.
